News

Research updates & milestones

Recent papers, appointments and research milestones.

  1. 2026

    Altermagnetic Proximity Effect published in Physical Review Letters

    Our collaborative work on the altermagnetic proximity effect appeared in Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 186702 (2026).

  2. 2026

    Magnetoelectric coupling in perovskite altermagnets

    Our collaborative study of symmetry-driven magnetoelectric coupling appeared in Advanced Science, e00004 (2026).

  3. 2026

    New preprint on gate-switchable topological transport

    Our preprint investigates helical and chiral topological transport in altermagnets with spin-valley-momentum locking (arXiv:2603.06487).

  4. Dec 2025

    Research Assistant Professor at IDT and EIT, Ningbo

    I started as a Research Assistant Professor at the Ningbo Institute of Digital Twin and Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo, continuing my research in Prof. Tong Zhou's group.

  5. 10 Nov 2025

    Postdoctoral final dissertation defense

    I successfully passed my postdoctoral final dissertation defense.

  6. 5 Jun 2025

    Electrically switchable quantum anomalous and spin Hall states

    Our work on coexisting and electrically tunable quantum anomalous and quantum spin Hall states in honeycomb lattices with non-Dirac bands was published in Physical Review B.

  7. 13 Dec 2023

    Postdoctoral proposal dissertation defense

    I successfully passed my postdoctoral proposal dissertation defense.

  8. 26 Sep 2023

    Postdoctoral research at EIAS, Ningbo

    I started my postdoctoral research in Prof. Tong Zhou's group in Ningbo in September 2023.

  9. 16 Jun 2023

    Ph.D. from Lanzhou University

    I received my Ph.D. from Lanzhou University in June 2023.
